More About Northwestern Engineering
IEMS Announces AI-Augmented Decision Systems Major
One of the first programs of its kind, the new undergraduate program prepares students to use AI, machine learning, and operations research to make better decisions and lead AI-enabled change.Read more
Dow Partnership Advances Recyclable Polymer Technology
An award recognizes the Northwestern-Dow collaboration spearheaded by Professor John Torkelson to develop recyclable durable crosslinked polymers while advancing the materialâs commercial applications.Read more
New Spin Transfer Mechanism Discovered in Antiferromagnets
Professor Pedram Khalili and his team demonstrated a new way to electrically switch antiferromagnets, with potential uses in memory, computing, and terahertz technology.Read more
Blink-Powered Glasses Could Keep an Eye on Health
New smart glasses developed by Professor Nivedita Arora harvest mechanical energy from facial movements to power sensors.Read more
Engineering News
Matthew Elwin Named Assistant Dean for Masterâs Programs
Elwin brings his experience in robotics education to a new role on the schoolâs leadership team.
Student Team Wins National Prize for ICU Hydration Monitoring Device
Four BME students turned an open-ended capstone challenge into a device designed for existing ICU workflows, earning the Kidney Technology Development Prize in the 2026 DEBUT Challenge.
Northwestern Lauded for Its Integrated Approach to Entrepreneurship
Northwestern University has been named the 2026 Center of Entrepreneurial Excellence, recognizing the strength and impact of its entrepreneurial ecosystem and its commitment to helping students and other community members turn ideas into ventures.
Jonathan Rivnay Receives Blavatnik Award for Young Scientists
Rivnayâs soft bioelectronics and living pharmacy devices were recognized with the prestigious award that comes with a $250,000 prize.

Academic Offerings
Uniquely innovative and interdisciplinary
Undergraduate Programs
Become a whole-brain thinker by working at the intersection of careful analysis and wild creativity. Earn your bachelor's degree; supplement your Northwestern education with a certificate, minor, or key course; and conduct research alongside pioneering faculty.
View undergraduate programs
Full- and Part-time Master's Programs
Our diverse masterâs degree programs are tailored to fit the constant changes of modern workplaces and your personal career needs. Youâll find yourself poised to make immediate and lasting impact, both at work and in the broader world.
View full-time programs

PhD Programs
Prepare yourself to innovate and perform at the highest level of academia or the private sector by studying and working alongside our world-class faculty members on advanced engineering research topics.

We offer a dynamic ecosystem of interdisciplinary programs ranging from design, entrepreneurship, leadership, and complexity. Transcend the boundaries of disciplines and learn to reframe problems to discover innovative ideas and solutions.
